issues.description: The exercise requires implementing getters for each attribute (used by the tests and described in the task), but the solution implementation declares some getters with private visibility (getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents()). This visibility mismatch prevents external access to those getters and is inconsistent with the task expectation that getters be accessible (and with the other getters in the solution which are public). As a result, tests or student code expecting public getters will fail or be unable to read these attributes.
issues.suggestedFix: Make all attribute getters public to match the exercise instructions and the other getter methods. Specifically, change getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() from private to public in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java, ensuring consistent visibility for all getters and aligning the implementation with the task and tests.
